events.description: Called with the key of every action chosen, after the action's own `onPress`.
events.name: onAction

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The accessible name of the button, read in place of its icon, for example "Actions for order 1001".
props.name: label

props.description: The groups of actions, in order, with a divider between them.
props.name: sections

props.description: The icon of the button: an icon name or any icon element. Defaults to `ellipsis`, which the app registers.
props.name: icon

props.description: The emphasis of the button. Defaults to `ghost`, which sits quietly in a row.
props.name: variant

props.description: The size of the button. Defaults to `md`.
props.name: size

props.description: True to refuse opening the menu; the button shows the disabled style.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The side of the trigger it opens on, by reading direction. The runtime flips it when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Where along that side it lines up with the trigger. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: align
